KaTeX 0.19.0 browser bundle, from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.0.tgz

MIT license retained in katex/LICENSE. Only the minified browser script, stylesheet,
and WOFF2 fonts are bundled. Unused WOFF/TTF alternatives were removed from the
stylesheet. All math rendering and fonts work offline. No runtime CDN requests.
